title: Pokémon Cards And Toys Are Officially Returning To McDonald's Happy Meals Soon
summary:
Rowlett McDowlett.

Brace yourselves, folks, because it looks like Pokémon cards will soon be returning to McDonald's Happy Meals in the US, and that has spelt trouble in the past (thanks for the heads up, IGN).

As reported by PokéBeach, a new set of TCG tie-ins will be available from the Big M between 5th November and 9th December, with 15 cards included in the collection. As ever, the Happy Meal bonuses will consist of a four-card pack, containing three normal cards and one holo.

title: Japanese Charts: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort And Final Fantasy Resonance Go Head-To-Head
summary:
Ding, ding! Round one!

Famitsu has given us our latest look at the Japanese charts, and it's another big week for new releases.

Nintendo Switch Sports Resort just about managed to take home the gold medal in its debut week, pulling in over 64,000 sales. Final Fantasy Resonance put up a strong fight in the following three places, mind you, with its Switch 2, PS5 and Switch 1 releases combining for over 133,000 purchases in week one.

title: The Duskbloods Switch 2 Release Has Been Delayed To 2027
summary:
There will (eventually) be Blood.

As will come as very little surprise to all those aware of the ever-shrinking time left in the '2026' window, FromSoftware has today announced that its Switch 2 exclusive, The Duskbloods, will not be launching as originally planned this year, but is instead being pushed to 2027.

The studio didn't give a precise new release date, but confirmed that it is taking extra time "for final adjustments to game rules and balancing".

title: Nintendo Download: 29th October (North America)
summary:
Hello Kitty! Darkest Dungeon! Peak!

The latest Nintendo Download update for North America has arrived, and it's bringing new games galore to the eShop. As always, be sure to drop a vote in our poll and comment down below with your potential picks for the week. Enjoy!

Switch 2 eShop - Highlights

Minecraft for Nintendo Switch 2 (Mojang, 27th Oct, $29.99) - Survive the night or create a work of art in the iconic sandbox game! Build anything you can imagine, uncover mysteries and face foes in an infinite world that’s unique in every playthrough. The Nintendo Switch 2 version features the Vibrant Visuals graphics upgrade, which brings improved visual elements, as well as the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack, where you can explore a custom Mario themed world! The pack also features 15 tracks and 40 player skins inspired by the iconic Super Mario series. title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A's Latest Mystery Gift Distribution Is Now Live
summary:
Spewpa Duper.

The catchily-titled 'Pokémon Legends: Z-A - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Mega Dimension' releases today, and to mark the occasion, The Pokémon Company has launched a new Mystery Gift distribution in the game.

This one is all about Spewpa and its multi-coloured evolution. Those who redeem the Mystery Gift via the internet between today (29th October) and 19th November at 1:59am UTC will redeem one of the adorable little caterpillar Pokémon for free. But this Spewpa is a special one, since it can evolve into one of 16 different Vivillon patterns that aren't currently available in the Z-A base game.

title: Palworld Dev Open To Switch 2 Release, If There's Ever An "Opportunity"
summary:
The Pocketpair team thinks it's a "really amazing platform".

Despite Pocketpair's ongoing legal battle with Nintendo, the developer is apparently open to bringing its monster-taming survival game Palworld to Switch 2 one day.

In a new interview with VGC recently, Pocketpair CEO Takuru Mizobe has praised the Switch 2, calling it a "really amazing platform", and says the team would love to see Palworld on the new hybrid system, if there's a "future" that presents this kind of opportunity.

title: Walmart Cancels Zelda Switch 2 Pre-Orders A Day Before Release
summary:
The retailer reportedly "oversold" orders.

The Zelda-themed Switch 2 is out this week, and Walmart has reportedly cancelled some pre-orders at the last minute.

As highlighted by Kotaku, some buyers have apparently received a message from Walmart notifying them that their pre-order has been cancelled as the item is now out of stock. They won't be charged, but this information was only shared a day before the expected arrival, so they're no longer getting a system.

title: Feature: 4 Things You Need To Know About Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition On Nintendo Switch 2
summary:
Can you build the perfect city?

Publisher Paradox Interactive recently released Cities: Skylines - Expanded Edition, a significantly revamped version of the original game, on Nintendo Switch 2. With better visuals, performance, and tools, it gives Nintendo Switch 2 players a definitive way to experience the city builder’s impressive scale.

If you’re not already familiar with it, Cities: Skylines is an in-depth single-player building sim where you’re mayor of a city that starts as an empty plot of land connected to a nearby highway. It’s up to you to create roads, houses, office buildings, and industrial areas to grow your city while maintaining its infrastructure with power, water, and other services to keep everything running smoothly

Lite up your life.

title: "Morale Has Been Terrible" - EA Workers Criticise Publisher's Cost-Cutting After Latest Layoffs
summary:
The mass effect of mass affects.

Last week, legendary RPG studio BioWare announced that it was shutting up shop as part of EA's latest round of layoffs. It was one of many studios hit by cuts from the company on the same day, which supposedly wiped out around 400 jobs.

One week on, and several current and former EA employees have anonymously spoken to Vertical Slice about their time at the publisher. Unsurprisingly, they paint a rather bleak picture of what it's like behind closed doors in 2026.

title: Minecraft Has Been Updated To Ver. 26.60 On Switch 2, Here Are The Full Patch Notes
summary:
New experimental biomes! Blocks! Projectiles!

Minecraft launched on Switch 2 earlier this week, and Mojang was quick to release a new update to make sure that everything is running as it should.

The biggest additions this time around mainly fall into the 'Experimental Game Drops' category, with the Ice Cave biome, Ice Crystals, Icicles, and Frostbite Zombie all available. As ever, there's a huge list of fixes included in the ver. 26.60 update too, including a couple of Switch 2-specific tweaks — hello, improved split screen performance!

title: Nintendo Apparently Has A Policy To Prevent Game-Key Cards Getting A Full-Cart Reprint
summary:
According to a Canadian retailer, that is.

After Nintendo seemingly introduced smaller cartridge size options earlier this year, many of us wondered whether our favourite Game-Key Card releases might get a proper full-cart physical reprint down the line. Well, according to Canadian retailer Video Games Plus, that might not be possible (thanks for the heads-up, Nintendo Wire).

In a now-deleted post on social media, VGP said the following: "As we’ve stated many times, we’d actively try to get existing Game-Key Card titles reprinted as full-on-cart versions, but at the moment, there’s a Nintendo policy preventing that.” Hmm.
